# CHID — 최은준 Eun Jun Choi, Industrial Designer (Seoul)

> Portfolio of Eun Jun Choi (최은준, CHID), an industrial / product designer studying Industrial Design at Hongik University, Seoul. James Dyson Award 2026 national finalist.

## Projects
- [SNAKED](https://chid.kr/projects/snaked.html): rescue stretcher for collapsed environments; James Dyson Award 2026 national finalist
- [KUNST](https://chid.kr/projects/kunst.html): augmented reality docent glasses for exhibitions (2025)
- [Seesaw](https://chid.kr/projects/seesaw.html): posture-correction wearable and app for active seniors
- [Foldisafe](https://chid.kr/projects/foldiSafe.html): collapsible medical suction liner bag, with COREAMED (2025)
- [KFW 2026](https://chid.kr/projects/kfw.html): KATUSA-US Soldier Friendship Week 2026 branding
